name: @neverland-money/address-book
description: Address book for Neverland Lending protocol contract addresses
author: Neverland Team

scripts.check-types: cd ../.. && tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --module commonjs --noEmit
scripts.build: cd ../.. && tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/address-book/tsconfig.json --module commonjs --outDir ./packages/address-book/dist/cjs
